This workflow is based on @Faeia's Workflow from herFaeTastic Details Flux LoRA.

V3:

  • checkout this awesomeLlama Install Guide

  • and mywildcard guide

V2:

  • changed LoRA to CR LoRA Stack

  • added Image Saver Node to save metadata for civitai uploads ;)

  • added LoRA for Upscaling, too

V1:

  • added wildcard support

  • uses GGUF loader for GGUF Flux models (check out @RalFinger's recent uploads

  • you can choose a different model for upscaling

  • Elemental LoRA releases tomorrow :)

Note:Using Dev first and Schnell for upscaling works better for LoRAs. It's a bit faster, too. :)
